mostWorthwhile.text: Making supporting fibers was most worthwhile: it connected protein production inside cells to the material that supports tissue outside them.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the finished fibers to the body felt predictable after making them, though it showed where they contribute.

surprise.text: I was interested that cells make material that becomes part of their surroundings.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; the compatible options had clear purposes, although the final two combinations were the only available actions.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: the links between cell work and tissue repair held my interest, although the later choices became predictable.
